senses.sense_definition: An excessive concentration on or single-minded obsession with one particular thing or idea.

examples.text: His passion for collecting antique clocks gradually turned into an all-consuming <w>monomania</w>.
It was apparent to all of us that her sudden interest had become a dangerous <w>monomania</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A historical psychological condition characterized by a delusion or obsessive fixation centered on a single topic, while remaining rational in other respects.

examples.text: Nineteenth-century doctors frequently diagnosed patients exhibiting an idée fixe with forms of <w>monomania</w>.
The psychiatrist argued that the patient suffered from a severe form of religious <w>monomania</w>.
